# italki

> > italki is a global language learning platform connecting students with teachers for personalized online language lessons and community-driven language practice.

The platform features a community forum where learners ask grammar questions, discuss language nuances, and receive feedback from native speakers and fellow students. italki supports learning across multiple languages with a focus on practical conversation skills and cultural understanding.

## Key Topics

- Russian grammar
- Language learning
- Grammar questions
- Genitive case
- Adjective forms
- Short-form adjectives
- Sentence structure
- Case usage
- Russian expressions
- Language forum
- Russian language learning
- Native speaker feedback
- Online language education

## Community Language Questions

- [Магазин открыто или открыт?](https://www.italki.com/en/post/8PzDuqZdt6hKH2dJaEaHz1): Russian grammar question about short-form adjective usage
- [Который правильно? 《он без очков 》или《У него без очков 》?](https://www.italki.com/en/post/9cGk6fTnhJ0aV32N4Q2kcy): Russian genitive case and sentence structure question by Andre Wang
- [В чем разница подает вида или видУ?](https://www.italki.com/en/post/YEec3f7c3joqERDu3J2394): Russian grammar question by Aya about genitive case in expressions
